description:
Request a DMARC DNS check

Reads stored DMARC policy diagnostics for a v2 Email domain. Checking queues a bounded DNS observation; it never edits DNS or changes sending permissions. Missing, malformed, multiple and unavailable are distinct. A valid record does not prove any individual message passes DMARC. p=none monitors only. Records may be inherited; existing policies must not be overwritten. Domain Connect is optional.

API reference: https://photon.codes/docs/beta/api-reference/email-domains/request-a-dmarc-dns-check
name: checkEmailDmarc
